## Checklist

- [ ] `uvx ruff check src tests` passes
- [ ] `uv run dah pack validate` passes (if content packs or schemas changed)
- [ ] Docs updated if user-visible behaviour changed (docs/en and docs/ru, README.md and README.ru.md, docs/SLICE.md)
- [ ] Texts that agents see stay the same for every kind of player: swarm, single agent, human, bot (if any changed)
